source.quote: Greetings, travelers, and welcome back to Goldbound, the challenge series where we're unlocking Azeroth one zone at a time. Each new zone sealed behind the purchase of a fresh WoW token. And so far, we've conquered Elwin Forest, Redidge Mountains, Burning Steps, and the Swamp of Soros. And most recently, we've broke ground in Westfall, a zone that has given us some surprisingly steady but low grinds and a few transmog options. But maybe most importantly, a whole new path forward with bigger bags from the heroic version of Deadlines. And travelers, if we want to keep the momentum rolling, we've got no choice but to dig in, gear up, and continue the grind. So, let's get after it. But, we've got some big pieces of news from World of Warcraft to cover. Updates that may have a massive impact on Goldie and our zone locked adventures. Because usually our unlocks come from accessing new zones, but this time they may come from new updates. And the first one is huge. Playerowned housing is coming to World of Warcraft. And player owned housing comes out on December 2nd, so by the time this video is live, it'll already be out. And this allows players to purchase, design, and decorate their own homes, full customization, decor, furniture, appearances, and all these come from vendors, quests, achievements, dungeons, raids, but most importantly for us, crafting. And here's the big thing. A lot of the crafting materials for housing decor comes from vanilla zones. the exact materials that we've been farming in our unlocked zones, which means one thing. Demand is about to go way up and the prices, well, I expect them to go up with it. So, I've managed to gather a list of items that appear in player housing beta. And travelers, we have a stockpile list. And while we're getting ready for player housing, let's talk about something else that helps me get ready for the day, our sponsor, AG1. And as we head into the winter season, not only is player housing on the horizon, but so are all the things that tank our immune systems.
